args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Reviewing release history confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy and that **v2.3.0** was the most recent release that had been healthy in production.

2. **Rolled back**: checkout-api was rolled back to v2.3.0 in all production regions.

3. **Verified recovery**: The service is now reporting **healthy** across all regions with an error rate of 0.2%.

4. **Opened incident**: SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy") was created describing the failure and the rollback mitigation. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Follow-up recommended: root-cause the v2.3.1 failure before re-attempting that release.
